def show(sid, filt=None):

    print('=====', sid, 'step', d['step_index'])
    for e in d['elements']:
        s=e['selector'] or ''
        if filt and filt not in s and filt not in (e['dom_id'] or ''):
            continue
        vb=e.get('visible_box')
        box = ('%.0f,%.0f %.0fx%.0f' % (vb['x'],vb['y'],vb['w'],vb['h'])) if vb else 'no-vbox'
        a=e['a11y']
        print('%7s %-6s role=%-8s name=%r text=%r sel=%-34s box=%-16s vis=%s inview=%s a11y=%s' % (e['id'], e['tag'], str(e['role']), e['name'], e['text'][:60], s[:34], box, e['visible'], e['in_viewport'], json.dumps({k:a[k] for k in ('name_source','invalid','error_message','focusable','tabindex','hidden')}, ensure_ascii=False)))
for sid in ['S-P1-page1-005','S-P1-page1-006','S-P1-page1-007']:
    show(sid, filt='cola')
